events.title: Kickoff and teardown
events.summary: The project opened with a request for a nonfunctional Control|24 unit to tear down and study before drawing the replacement.

events.title: Architecture strategy locked
events.summary: The surface design and initial requirements were established, with only minor dimensional changes expected rather than a wholesale footprint change.

events.title: DCD geometric-control system
events.summary: The construction review was canceled so the team could release Data Control Drawings as fast as possible and make the PCB-to-chassis interfaces explicit.

events.title: First verified DCD release packet
events.summary: Revision 1 geometry was delivered for twelve PCB identifiers.

events.title: DCD coverage expanded
events.summary: Four more PCB identifiers entered the release set while four pending interfaces were called out explicitly.

events.title: DCD revisions advanced
events.summary: Two remaining boards were added and ten controlled drawings advanced revision while unresolved inputs stayed visible.

events.title: Eighteen-board DCD index
events.summary: The release status enumerated current revision levels across 18 unique PCB DCD identifiers.

events.title: Encoder-board geometry revised
events.summary: DCD 9150-55153 reached revision 4 after holes were removed and tooling holes moved.

events.title: Communications-board DCD revised
events.summary: DCD 9150-55198 advanced to revision 3.

events.title: Automation-board DCD revised
events.summary: The Auto A drawing, 9150-55156, reached revision 4.

events.title: Phase 1 exit delivered
events.summary: The later delivered-milestone record places Phase 1 exit on October 21, 2006.

events.title: Domestic fabrication bridge
events.summary: Mass Precision confirmed corrected revision models and PDFs while the bridge parts were already in process.

events.title: Top-panel no-bid documented
events.summary: The March 7 status report records Kwanta's top-panel no-bid and the active Operations/Manufacturing response. By April 4, the matter was before Kwanta's board, with Mass Precision and Kenny identified as bridge options.
events.verification_note: March 7 is the earliest located primary report that states the no-bid; it is a reporting checkpoint, not a claimed occurrence date.

events.title: Headphone-jack field-failure redesign
events.summary: A 4.8% service history and a two-hour teardown triggered a recessed, field-serviceable mounting redesign. The urgent July 12 change order is internally numbered ECO 12993 but archived under ECO_12996; conflicting part fields are preserved rather than inferred.
events.verification_note: The email and change-order claims agree on the mounting change; the archived filename and internal ECO number differ.

events.title: Proto 3 build opened
events.summary: The delivered-milestone record places the Proto 3 build start on June 18.

events.title: Proto 3 build completed
events.summary: The delivered-milestone record places Proto 3 completion on July 2.

events.title: Proto 3 warp and fixture-ECO recovery
events.summary: The paint-process study measured side-cap flatness as high as 2.50 mm. Vertical Method A constrained deformation, and ECO 12740 released the changed plastic geometry to production.

events.title: Release to manufacturing
events.summary: The delivered-milestone record marks release to manufacturing complete on August 16.

events.title: Pilot build started
events.summary: Pilot build started August 20.

events.title: Pilot build completed
events.summary: Pilot build completed August 31.

events.title: Production started
events.summary: Production start was delivered September 6.

events.title: At Risk to On Schedule
events.summary: Status moved from At Risk to On Schedule while the current First Customer Ship plan rebased from October 29 to November 7.

events.title: First units delivered
events.summary: The first production units were delivered October 15.

events.title: First Customer Ship
events.summary: First Customer Ship was delivered November 7, 2007. November 20 was the original Phase 1 plan, not the delivered milestone.
events.verification_note: The final governance schedule explicitly labels November 7 as delivered FCS.

events.title: Sustaining transition
events.summary: ECO 13707 was finalized and the team prioritized the next C|24 changes as project work shifted into sustaining support.
events.verification_note: The archive filename supplies the historical date; the document's dynamic date field was refreshed in 2025.

clusters.label: DCD release sequence
clusters.summary: Seven primary email checkpoints document 18 unique PCB DCD identifiers from April 18 through June 27, 2006.

conflicts.resolution: Seven dated checkpoints and 18 unique identifiers replace the unsupported 19-release/14-assembly count.
The change order is internally ECO 12993, the archive filename says ECO_12996, and conflicting part fields are not inferred.
Delivered FCS was November 7, 2007; November 20 was the Phase 1 plan.
December 21, 2007 comes from the archive filename because the document's dynamic date field drifted.
